column1: # Cells of the calculation type table on precedence and on overflow in every context, see
# docs/spec/calculation.md. Format of calculation.tsv, with these additions:
# - a negative number literal (-7) is one operand, a sign (- 7) is an operator; + is a sign that changes nothing;
# - an expression |{ ... }| is a string template with one embedded expression, CONV type( ... ) and
#   EXACT type( ... ) the constructor operators (p16.0 stands for a type p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 0);
# - ADD, SUBTRACT, MULTIPLY and DIVIDE are statements on the result field;
# - a target type[value] with an expression that is not an assignment operator is a result field with that start
# - EXC:<class>,<value>: the exception is raised and the result field holds <value> afterwards.

column2: CONV i( a - a + a + c )
CONV int8( a - a + a + c )
CONV p16.0( a - a + a + c )
CONV f( a - a + a + c )
CONV decfloat34( a - a + a + c )
